Description: Let show hosts publish recording slots in their time zone and block dates they are unavailable.
Let guests book an interview slot through a secure link and get a calendar invite automatically.
Collect structured talking points and biography links from guests and organise them on an episode board.
Turn the episode board into a timestamped run-of-show and export it as a PDF production sheet.
As a show host, I want to publish recording slots with date, start time and duration, so that guests can only book times I have offered.
As a show host, I want to block dates when I am unavailable, so that no guest can book me on those days.
As a podcast guest, I want to see open slots in my own time zone, so that I do not turn up at the wrong hour.
As a podcast guest, I want to pick an open slot from the host's booking page, so that my interview is confirmed without email back-and-forth.
As a podcast guest, I want to receive a calendar invite as soon as I book, so that the recording is in my calendar with the link.
As a podcast guest, I want to join a waitlist when no slots are open, so that I am told when the host adds new times.
As a show host, I want booking links to be unguessable and expire after use or 14 days, so that strangers cannot book fake interviews or read guest details.
As a podcast guest, I want to submit 3-10 bullet-point discussion topics when I book, so that the host knows what I want to talk about.
As a podcast guest, I want to add links to my bio and past work, so that the host can introduce me properly.
As a show host, I want to see all guest outlines on one board and reorder topics, so that I can plan the flow of the episode.
As a show host, I want start times to be calculated from each segment's planned duration, so that I know exactly when each topic starts during recording.
As a show host, I want to export the run-of-show as a PDF in under 1 second, so that I can share it with my producer right before recording.
